cands.sql: SELECT T2.closing_time, T3.day_of_week FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city LIKE 'Scottsdale' AND T1.active LIKE 'TRUE' AND T1.stars > ( SELECT AVG(T1.stars) * 0.6 FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city LIKE 'Scottsdale' AND T1.active LIKE 'TRUE' )

SELECT T1.closing_time, T2.day_of_week FROM Business_Hours AS T1 INNER JOIN Days AS T2 ON T1.day_id = T2.day_id INNER JOIN Business AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T3.active LIKE 'TRUE' AND T3.city LIKE 'Scottsdale' AND T3.stars * 100 > ( SELECT AVG(stars) FROM Business ) * 60

SELECT T3.closing_time, T3.day_of_week FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city = 'Scottsdale' AND T1.active = 'true' AND T1.stars > ( SELECT AVG(T1.stars) * 0.6 FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city = 'Scottsdale' AND T1.active = 'true' )

SELECT T2.closing_time, T3.day_of_week FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city = 'Scottsdale' AND T1.active LIKE 'TRUE' AND T1.stars * 100 > ( SELECT AVG(T1.stars) * 60 FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.city = 'Scottsdale' AND T1.active LIKE 'TRUE' )

SELECT T1.closing_time, T2.day_of_week FROM Business_Hours AS T1 INNER JOIN Days AS T2 ON T1.day_id = T2.day_id INNER JOIN Business AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id WHERE T3.city LIKE 'Scottsdale' AND T3.active LIKE 'TRUE' GROUP BY T3.stars HAVING T3.stars > AVG(T3.stars) * 0.6

SELECT DISTINCT T1.closing_time, T3.day_of_week FROM Business_Hours AS T1 INNER JOIN Days AS T2 ON T1.day_id = T2.day_id INNER JOIN Business AS T3 ON T1.business_id = T3.business_id INNER JOIN Business_Categories AS T4 ON T3.business_id = T4.business_id INNER JOIN Categories AS T5 ON T4.category_id = T5.category_id WHERE T3.active = 'true' AND T3.city = 'Scottsdale' AND T3.stars > 0.6 * ( SELECT AVG(T3.stars) FROM Business AS T3 INNER JOIN Business_Categories AS T4 ON T3.business_id = T4.business_id INNER JOIN Categories AS T5 ON T4.category_id = T5.category_id )

SELECT DISTINCT T2.closing_time, T3.day_of_week FROM Business AS T1 INNER JOIN Business_Hours AS T2 ON T1.business_id = T2.business_id INNER JOIN Days AS T3 ON T2.day_id = T3.day_id WHERE T1.active LIKE 'TRUE' AND T1.city LIKE 'Scottsdale' AND T1.stars > ( SELECT AVG(stars) * 0.6 FROM Business )

SELECT SUM(REPLACE(T2.`Unit Price`, ',', '') - REPLACE(T2.`Unit Cost`, ',', '')) / COUNT(T1.ProductID) FROM Products AS T1 INNER JOIN `Sales Orders` AS T2 ON T2._ProductID = T1.ProductID WHERE T2.`Order Quantity` > 5 AND T1.`Product Name` = 'Bar Tools'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.State = 'Oregon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T3.State) FROM reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN state AS T3 ON T2.state_abbrev = T3.StateCode

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T3.district_id) AS average FROM reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T3.state = 'Oregon'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.State = 'Oregon' THEN T1.district_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.district_id) FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN reviews AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN state AS T3 ON T1.state_abbrev = T3.StateCode

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.State = 'Oregon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.district_id) FROM reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN state AS T3 ON T2.state_abbrev = T3.StateCode WHERE T3.Region = 'West'
SELECT AVG(T3.Stars) FROM state AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.StateCode = T2.state_abbrev INNER JOIN reviews AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.State = 'Oregon'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.State = 'Oregon' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.district_id) FROM reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN state AS T3 ON T2.state_abbrev = T3.StateCode

SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.Stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(T3.district_id) FROM reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T2.state = 'Oregon'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.Stars) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(T2.state = 'Oregon', 1, 0)) FROM reviews AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
SELECT T.game_name FROM game AS T ORDER BY LENGTH(T.game_name) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T.game_name FROM ( SELECT T2.game_name, LENGTH(T2.game_name) AS num FROM game_platform AS T1 INNER JOIN game AS T2 ON T1.game_publisher_id = T2.id ) T ORDER BY T.num DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.HomePage, T3.AuthorId FROM Journal AS T1 INNER JOIN Paper AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.JournalId INNER JOIN PaperAuthor AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PaperId WHERE T2.Year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005 AND T2.Title LIKE '%SOCIAL%'

SELECT T1.HomePage, T3.AuthorId FROM Journal AS T1 INNER JOIN Paper AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.JournalId INNER JOIN PaperAuthor AS T3 ON T2.Id = T3.PaperId WHERE T2.Year >= 2000 AND T2.Year < 2006 AND T2.Title LIKE '%SOCIAL%'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.HomePage, T2.AuthorId FROM Paper AS T1 INNER JOIN PaperAuthor AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PaperId INNER JOIN Journal AS T3 ON T1.JournalId = T3.Id WHERE T1.Year >= 2000 AND T1.Year < 2006 AND T1.Title LIKE '%SOCIAL%'

SELECT T1.groupYear - ( SELECT T1.groupYear FROM torrents AS T1 INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.releaseType = 'album' AND T1.artist LIKE '%2Pac%' ORDER BY T1.groupYear ASC LIMIT 1, 1 ) AS "years_passed" FROM torrents AS T1 INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.releaseType = 'album' AND T1.artist LIKE '%2Pac%' AND T1.groupYear = 1991

SELECT T1.groupYear - ( SELECT groupYear FROM torrents WHERE releaseType = 'album' AND artist LIKE '2Pac' ORDER BY groupYear LIMIT 1, 1 ) AS result FROM torrents AS T1 INNER JOIN torrents AS T2 ON T1.artist = T2.artist WHERE T1.artist LIKE '2Pac' AND T1.releaseType = 'album'

SELECT groupYear - ( SELECT groupYear FROM torrents WHERE releaseType = 'album' AND artist LIKE '2Pac%' LIMIT 1 ) AS result FROM torrents WHERE artist LIKE '2Pac%' AND groupYear = 1991 ORDER BY groupYear DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM((1991 - (SELECT MIN(T2.groupYear) FROM torrents AS T2 WHERE T2.releaseType = 'album')) - (1991 - T2.groupYear)) FROM torrents AS T2 WHERE T2.artist LIKE '2Pac' AND T2.releaseType LIKE 'album'
SELECT groupYear - ( SELECT groupYear FROM torrents WHERE releaseType = 'album' LIMIT 1, 1 ) AS yearsPassed FROM torrents WHERE artist = '2Pac' AND groupYear = 1991 LIMIT 1
SELECT 1991 - MIN(groupYear) FROM torrents WHERE artist LIKE '2Pac' AND groupYear != 1991 AND releaseType LIKE 'album'

SELECT MAX(T.groupYear) - MIN(T.groupYear) AS calu FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN T.releaseType LIKE 'album' THEN T.groupYear END AS groupYear FROM torrents AS T WHERE T.artist LIKE '2Pac' ) AS T WHERE T.groupYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT 1992 - ( SELECT MIN(T1.groupYear) FROM torrents AS T1 INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id WHERE T1.releaseType = 'album' AND T1.artist LIKE '2Pac' )

SELECT T1.Team_Name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.match_winner WHERE T2.Match_Date LIKE '2011%' AND T2.Win_Margin < ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) * 0.3 FROM Match WHERE Match_Date LIKE '2011%' )

SELECT T2.Team_Name, T3.Team_Name FROM `Match` AS T1 INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.Team_Id = T1.Team_1 INNER JOIN Team AS T3 ON T3.Team_Id = T1.Team_2 WHERE T1.Match_Date LIKE '2011%' AND T1.Win_Margin < 0.3 * ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) FROM `Match` WHERE Match_Date LIKE '2011%' )

SELECT T1.Team_Name, T3.Team_Name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.Team_1 INNER JOIN Match AS T3 ON T1.team_id = T3.Team_2 WHERE T2.Match_Date LIKE '2011%' AND T3.Win_Margin * 100 / ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) FROM Match ) * 30 < T2.Win_Margin ORDER BY T2.Win_Margin ASC LIMIT 1, 1

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN Win_Margin * 100 / ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) FROM `Match` WHERE Match_Date LIKE '2011%' ) > 30 THEN Team_1 ELSE Team_2 END, CASE WHEN Win_Margin * 100 / ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) FROM `Match` WHERE Match_Date LIKE '2011%' ) < 30 THEN Team_1 ELSE Team_2 END FROM `Match` WHERE Match_Date LIKE '2011%'
SELECT T1.Team_Name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T2.Team_1 = T1.Team_Id WHERE T2.Match_Date LIKE '2011%' AND T2.Win_Margin * 100 < ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) * 30 FROM Match )

SELECT T1.Team_Name, T3.Team_Name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.Team_Id = T2.Team_1 INNER JOIN Team AS T3 ON T3.Team_Id = T2.Team_2 WHERE T2.Match_Date LIKE '2011%' AND T2.Win_Margin * 100 / ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) FROM Match ) < 30

SELECT T1.Team_Name, T3.Team_Name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.team_id = T2.team_1 OR T1.team_id = T2.team_2 INNER JOIN Team AS T3 ON T3.team_id = T2.match_winner WHERE T2.Match_Date LIKE '2011%' AND T2.Win_Margin * 100 / ( SELECT AVG(Win_Margin) FROM Match WHERE Match_Date LIKE '2011%' ) < 30 LIMIT 2
SELECT T2.Team_Name FROM `Match` AS T1 INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.Team_Id = T1.Team_1 WHERE T1.Match_Date LIKE '2011%' GROUP BY T1.Win_Margin HAVING T1.Win_Margin > AVG(T1.Win_Margin) * 0.3

SELECT SUM(T2.LastReceiptCost - T2.StandardPrice) FROM ProductVendor AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T1.BusinessEntityID = 740
SELECT SUM(T1.LastReceiptCost - T1.StandardPrice) FROM ProductVendor AS T1 INNER JOIN Product AS T2 ON T1.ProductID = T2.ProductID WHERE T2.ProductID = 740
SELECT T2.LastReceiptCost - T2.StandardPrice AS result FROM ProductVendor AS T1 INNER JOIN Vendor AS T2 ON T1.BusinessEntityID = T2.BusinessEntityID WHERE T1.ProductID = 740
SELECT T1.ProductName FROM Products AS T1 INNER JOIN Categories AS T2 ON T1.CategoryID = T2.CategoryID WHERE T2.CategoryName = 'Confections'
SELECT T2.ProductName FROM Categories AS T1 INNER JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.CategoryID = T2.CategoryID WHERE T1.CategoryName = 'Confections'
SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.year_id - T1.user_yelping_since_year) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.user_id) FROM Users AS T1 INNER JOIN Elite AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_fans LIKE 'Uber'
SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.year_id - T1.user_yelping_since_year) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.user_id) FROM Users AS T1 INNER JOIN Elite AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_fans = 'Uber'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.user_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.year_id) FROM Elite AS T1 INNER JOIN Users AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T2.user_fans LIKE 'Uber'
SELECT CAST(COUNT(year_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM Elite WHERE user_fans LIKE 'Uber'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.user_fans = 'Uber' THEN 2013 - T1.year_id ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.user_id) FROM Elite AS T1 INNER JOIN Users AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.year_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.user_id) FROM Users AS T1 INNER JOIN Elite AS T2 ON T1.user_id = T2.user_id WHERE T1.user_fans LIKE 'Uber'
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM Episode WHERE season = 9
SELECT AVG(T1.rating) FROM Episode AS T1 INNER JOIN Award AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.season = 9 AND T2.award_category = 'Season finale' GROUP BY T2.award
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM Episode WHERE season = 9 GROUP BY season
SELECT CAST(SUM(rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(episode_id) FROM Episode WHERE season = 9
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM Episode WHERE season = 9 GROUP BY episode_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_status AS T1 INNER JOIN order_history AS T2 ON T1.status_id = T2.status_id WHERE T1.status_value = 'Delivered' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.status_date) = '2021'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_status AS T1 INNER JOIN order_history AS T2 ON T1.status_id = T2.status_id WHERE T2.status_date LIKE '2021%' AND T1.status_value = 'Delivered'
